name: NASA ADS
tagline: Search NASA Astrophysics Data System literature, citations, and bibliographic records
description: The NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) API provides programmatic access to the ADS bibliographic database covering astronomy, astrophysics, physics, and related literature. Developers can search papers by query, retrieve full records, citation metrics, and related works using authenticated HTTP requests against Harvard-hosted endpoints.

auth.details: Bearer token (API token) in Authorization header; obtain from ADS user account settings after free signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free research use with API token after signup; exact public quotas not published as a simple plan page—see rate limits/API docs for any endpoint-specific soft limits

rate_limits: not published as a fixed public plan; rate-limit headers/docs may apply per endpoint when present—not simply a single hard daily number on the main help page
use_cases: search astrophysics papers by keyword or author
get citation counts and metrics for a paper
find related or citing works for a given paper
